memory_update.text: KRT is the highest-purity underfollowed US-listed small-cap for restaurant disposable packaging, with direct exposure to cups, lids, takeout containers, bags, eco-friendly products, custom printing, chain/distributor accounts, and logistics.
GPK is a mid-cap underfollowed foodservice paperboard packaging candidate; verify the materiality and margins of foodservice/QSR cups, trays, and containers within broader paperboard operations.

AMCR is a reference-scale public packaging name after the Berry Global merger, useful for foodservice cup/container capacity and recyclable/reusable cup context, but less pure due to broad global packaging exposure.

SEE is a second-order foodservice infrastructure candidate via Cryovac/Liquibox packaging for prepared foods, proteins, condiments, and beverages; restaurant exposure is indirect and requires revenue-mix validation.

Pactiv Evergreen would have been a direct public foodservice-packaging reference leader, but it was acquired by Novolex and delisted from Nasdaq on April 1, 2025; treat it as private competitive context, not a current US-listed candidate.

Several highly relevant foodservice packaging competitors are private or non-US-primary-listed, including Dart/Solo, Genpak, Novolex/Pactiv, Huhtamaki, and many custom cup/bag suppliers; this may make the public-market pure-play set unusually narrow.

The strongest chokepoint variables for this node are sustainable/PFAS/plastic compliance, national fulfillment, chain-level custom branding, resin/paper/freight pass-through, food-contact certifications, and ability to supply consistent SKUs across multi-unit restaurant systems.

node: Takeout, delivery, cold beverage, and prepared-food packaging/disposables
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for restaurant takeout/delivery/cold-beverage packaging. The strongest underfollowed candidate is Karat Packaging, a small-cap public company with direct disposable foodservice exposure, eco-friendly SKUs, chain/distributor sales, custom printing, and logistics. Graphic Packaging is a mid-cap paperboard/foodservice packaging candidate tied to cups, trays, containers, carry-out cartons, and QSR/foodservice providers. Amcor is a larger reference/context name after absorbing Berry Global, giving it scale in foodservice drink cups and reusable/recyclable cup systems, but its restaurant exposure is diluted by broad consumer/healthcare packaging. Sealed Air is a second-order prepared-food/foodservice infrastructure candidate through Cryovac and Liquibox systems that preserve shelf life, reduce labor, and support beverage/condiment/protein packaging for foodservice operators and suppliers. Pactiv Evergreen would have been a direct reference leader, but it was acquired by Novolex and delisted from Nasdaq on April 1, 2025, so it is a private-market coverage gap rather than a current US-listed candidate.
